title: 第3章
content_zh: 第三章 护短的大将军（1）就在两个小丫头六神无主，不知道该怎么和她们家老爷交待的时候，声音的主人已经到了她们所在的听雪轩，看着矗立在她们面前的高大身影，两人相互对视着，清秀美丽的脸蛋上，不禁露出一丝苦笑，唉，以老爷对小姐的宠爱程度，要是知道小姐做了这么危险的事，甚至到现在还没什么动静，也不知道里面怎么样了，老爷还不得发疯啊，况且以她们家老爷灵皇巅峰的实力，要是真发起疯来，放眼整个帝都还真没有人能拦的住他，唯一拦得住的那人，还是老爷最好的朋友。“你们两人不好好照顾小姐，站在外面干什么，是不是在偷赖？”刚回到将军府，还没来得及换衣服，就赶忙来看自己宝贝孙女的大将军冷擎天，满脸不悦地道，让这两丫头好好保护他的宝贝雪儿，谁知道这两丫头居然让他宝贝孙女受伤了，他一收到这消息就连夜往回赶，一刻都不敢耽搁，谁知道刚回来，就看到这两个他精挑细选的丫头站在雪儿的房门外，慌慌张张的，他这火气马上就上来了，哼，要不是在路上就收到消息，知道宝贝孙女已经醒过来了，他非现在就处置了她们不可。“老爷，是小姐让奴婢们守在外面的，小姐说不许任何人打扰。”非常了解她们家老爷脾气的绿桃，连忙道，她紧张的手心都攥出汗了，只盼着小姐能马上出现在老爷面前。“雪儿在房间里面做什么呢？”冷擎天的眼神幽深，神情高深莫测，可是语气却是淡淡的，听不出喜怒。“小姐……”“说，若敢有一点隐瞒，家法侍候！”冷擎天面容严肃，语气严厉的道，并刻意地释放出一丝威压，看来他不在府中这几天，连奴婢下人都敢不把他的话当回事了，看她们那慌张的样子，他就知道肯定有事。绿桃和翠竹‘扑通’一声跪在地上，她们两人的修为只有大灵师，根本受不了那凌厉霸气的威压，就在这时，房间的门突然打开了，一袭红衣的绝色少女，款款从里面走了出来，一时间，三人个全都呆愣住了。“小姐？”好不容易回过神来的绿桃和翠竹惊艳不已，全都犯起了花痴，口水都要流下来了。“你，你是我的雪儿吗？”冷擎天有些失神地，看着这张和他已经过世的儿媳有八分相似的脸蛋，喃喃道。“爷爷，您连自己的孙女都认不出来了吗？”冷若雪璀璨明亮的水眸，看着自己记忆中的爷爷撒娇的道，是的，在那傻若雪的记忆中，有这个极为护短、极为疼爱她的爷爷，傻若雪对自己爷爷感情极深，也极为依赖，她继承了那傻若雪的记忆和身体，对这个无条件地疼爱着傻若雪的老人，也感到非常的亲切，这个战场上被人誉为战神的老人，也让她有着一股无法言喻的孺慕之情，而这个老人对自己孙女的疼爱正是她一直以来都极为渴望的亲情，所以在没见到这老人之前，她就已经决定认下这个爷爷了，现在见到了，也就更加的坚定了她的想法，要知道她的爷爷可是东池国大名鼎鼎的战神、灵皇巅峰强者，无数人心目中崇拜的偶像，可是面前这头发凌乱、满脸胡茬、衣服上布满了灰尘，风尘仆仆的老人就是她的爷爷，帝国一等大将军，说出去恐怕都没人信。“哈哈哈…好，真是太好了，我的宝贝雪儿真的清醒了，爷爷真是太开心了，来，让爷爷好好看看！”满脸疯惫的冷擎天忍不住地开怀大笑起来，孙女病好了，她也算对得起死去的儿子和儿媳了。“爷爷，您赶了那么多天的路一定累坏了，先去休息下，好好睡一觉，孙女又跑不了，等爷爷休息好了，孙女让您看个够。”冷若雪绝美脸蛋上粉嫩的小嘴一撅，有些不依道。“爷爷不累，爷爷开心啊！”冷擎天的脸上是掩不住喜色，现在亲眼见到孙女清醒了，他才知道自己不是在做梦，多年的愿望终于成真了。“那爷爷总得去洗个澡，换件衣服吧！”冷若雪唇角带笑，明眸流转，调皮地说道。“对，对，是得洗个澡，看我这身上脏兮兮的，雪儿，你等等爷爷。”说完便没影了。“小姐！”绿桃和翠竹激动不已，看小姐周身灵气环绕，就知道小姐已经成功觉醒了。“你们还跪着干什么，起来吧！”冷若雪看了眼依然跪着的两个婢女，伸出一根纤纤玉指，指尖释放出一丝灵气，银白色的灵气在青葱玉指上缓缓流转。“银白色！大灵师……”翠竹忍不住惊呼出声，绿桃相对还算淡定，但两人都久久说不出话来，两天的时间，小姐就从一个灵力没有觉醒之人成为了一个大灵师，这是怎样妖孽的潜力啊，和小姐比起来，那些个所谓的天才还能叫天才吗？小姐生来就是打击人的吗？她们资质也算是不错的了，可是成为大灵师也用了差不多10年的时间，可是小姐却只用了两天，不，也许还不到两天呢，她们无语了。“雪儿。”梳洗完毕的冷擎天，迈着稳健的步子走了进来，不过他却感觉到屋里的气氛有点怪异，出什么事了吗？“咦，雪儿，你成大灵师了？”冷擎天惊讶不已，其实以他的修为看出雪儿的等级并不难，可是俗话说得好，关心则乱，刚才他的全部心思都放在了雪儿神智清醒上，还真没注意到雪儿的修为，毕竟谁能想得到，神智才清醒过来的人一下子就成了大灵师呢，突然，似乎想到了什么，冷擎天脸色一变。“这是什么时候的事？你们居然敢瞒着我，谁给你们的胆子，来人，把她们两个给我关起来，等候处置！”冷擎天满脸怒容地指着绿桃和翠竹，对守在门口的侍卫道，雪儿受伤这件事他还没来得及罚她们呢，这么大的事居然还敢瞒他！
content_en: Chapter 3 The general who protects the shortcomings (1) Just when the two little girls were confused and didn't know how to explain to their master, the owner of the voice had already arrived at the Tingxue Pavilion where they were. Looking at the tall figure standing in front of them, the two looked at each other, with a wry smile on their delicate and beautiful faces. Alas, with the master's love for the young lady, To the extent, if they knew that the young lady had done such a dangerous thing, and even now there was no movement, and they didn’t know what was going on inside, the master would have to go crazy. Moreover, with the peak strength of their master, the Spiritual Emperor, if he really went crazy, no one in the entire imperial capital could stop him. The only person who could stop him was the master’s best friend. "You two don't take good care of the young lady. Why are you standing outside? Are you cheating?" The general Leng Qingtian, who had just returned to the general's mansion and had not had time to change clothes, hurried to see his precious granddaughter, said with an unhappy face, asking these two girls to protect his precious Xue'er. Who knew that these two girls actually caused his precious granddaughter to be injured? As soon as he received the news, he rushed back all night, not daring to delay for a moment. Who would have expected that as soon as he came back, he saw the two girls he had carefully selected standing outside Xueer's room, panicking, and his anger immediately rose. Hum, if he hadn't received the news on the way and knew that his precious granddaughter had woken up, he would have to deal with them now. "Master, it was the young lady who asked the slaves to stay outside. The young lady said that no one is allowed to disturb her." Lu Tao, who knew their master's temper very well, said quickly. Her palms were so nervous that they were sweating, hoping that the young lady would appear in front of the master immediately. "What is Xue'er doing in the room?" Leng Qingtian's eyes were deep and unpredictable, but his tone was light and there was no hint of happiness or anger. "Miss..." "Say, if you dare to hide anything, I'll take care of you!" Leng Qingtian said with a serious face and a stern tone, and deliberately released a trace of coercion. It seems that in the past few days since he was absent from the house, even the servants dare not take his words seriously. Looking at their panic, he knew that something must be wrong. Lu Tao and Cuizhu knelt down on the ground with a plop. Their cultivation level was only that of a great spiritual master, and they could not withstand the fierce and domineering pressure. At this moment, the door of the room suddenly opened, and a stunning girl in red walked out. For a moment, all three of them were stunned. "Miss?" Lu Tao and Cuizhu, who finally came back to their senses, were so amazed that they all became nymphomaniacs and their mouths were drooling. "You, are you my Xue'er?" Leng Qingtian murmured with some confusion, looking at the face that was very similar to his deceased daughter-in-law. "Grandpa, can't you even recognize your granddaughter?" Leng Ruoxue's bright watery eyes looked at the grandfather in her memory and said coquettishly, yes, in the memory of Silly Ruoxue, there was this grandfather who was extremely protective of her and loved her very much. Silly Ruoxue said to her grandfather She has deep feelings and is extremely dependent. She inherited the memory and body of Sha Ruoxue. She also feels very kind to this old man who loves Sha Ruoxue unconditionally. This old man who is known as the God of War on the battlefield also makes her have an indescribable feeling of admiration. The old man's love for his granddaughter was the family affection that she had always longed for, so before she met the old man, she had already decided to recognize this grandpa. Now that she saw him, she was even more determined. She must know that her grandpa was a stranger. The famous God of War of the Chi Kingdom, the most powerful Spirit Emperor, and the idol worshiped by countless people, but the old man with messy hair, stubble on his face, and dusty clothes in front of him was her grandfather, a first-class general of the empire, and no one would believe it. "Hahaha... Okay, it's great. My baby Xue'er is really awake. Grandpa is so happy. Come on, let grandpa take a good look!" Leng Qingtian, who looked crazy and tired, couldn't help laughing. His granddaughter was cured of her illness, and she was worthy of her dead son and daughter-in-law. "Grandpa, you must be exhausted after traveling for so many days. Go and have a rest first and have a good sleep. Your granddaughter can't run away. When grandpa is rested, your granddaughter will let you see as much as you want." Leng Ruoxue pouted her pink mouth on her beautiful face, a little dissatisfied. "Grandpa is not tired, grandpa is happy!" Leng Qingtian couldn't hide the joy on his face. Now that he saw his granddaughter awake with his own eyes, he knew that he was not dreaming, and his long-cherished wish finally came true. "Then grandpa has to take a shower and change clothes!" Leng Ruoxue said mischievously with a smile on her lips and bright eyes. "Yes, yes, I need to take a shower. Look at how dirty I am. Xue'er, please wait for grandpa." After saying that, he disappeared. "Miss!" Lu Tao and Cuizhu were excited. Seeing the spiritual energy surrounding the lady, they knew that the lady had successfully awakened. "What are you still kneeling for? Get up!" Leng Ruoxue glanced at the two maids who were still kneeling, stretched out a slender jade finger, and released a trace of spiritual energy from the fingertips. The silvery white spiritual energy slowly circulated on the green jade fingers. "Silver white! Great Spirit Master..." Cuizhu couldn't help but exclaimed. Lu Tao was relatively calm, but both of them were speechless for a long time. In two days, the young lady went from a person with no spiritual power to awakening to a great spiritual master. What kind of evil potential is this? Compared with the young lady, can those so-called geniuses still be called geniuses? Are young ladies born to attack people? Their qualifications are pretty good, but it took almost 10 years to become a great spiritual master, but it only took the young lady two days, no, maybe less than two days, and they were speechless. "Xue'er." Leng Qingtian, who had finished dressing up, walked in with steady steps, but he felt that the atmosphere in the room was a bit strange. What happened?
